extension.description: Develop competitive-programming problems in VS Code: contest structure, live statement preview, judging and rendering.
view.contest.name: Contest Project
view.contest.welcome:
No Tuack contest found in this workspace.
The project root should contain a `conf.json` with `"folder": "contest"`.
[New contest project](command:tuack.gen.contest)
[Open contest project…](command:tuack.openContest)
[Diagnose environment](command:tuack.diagnose)
command.preview.showToSide: Open Statement Preview to the Side
config.title: Tuack
config.rpcPath.description: Path to the `tuack-ng-rpc` executable. Leave empty to auto-detect: workspace `tools/`, then `PATH`.
config.typstPath.description: Path to the `typst` executable (needed for PDF rendering). Leave empty to auto-detect from `PATH`.
config.assetsPath.description: Directory containing tuack-ng's assets (`langs.json` and `templates/`). Leave empty to use tuack-ng's own search order.
config.preview.engine.description: Markdown engine used by the statement preview.
config.preview.engine.bundled: Use the markdown-it bundled with this extension (recommended: stable output).
config.preview.engine.vscode-markdown: Use VS Code's built-in Markdown renderer (experimental: affected by user settings and other extensions).
config.preview.debounceMs.description: Debounce in milliseconds before refreshing the preview after an edit.
config.preview.saveBeforePreview.descrip: Save the statement before previewing. `ren/preview` reads from disk, so unsaved edits do not appear in the preview when this is disabled.
config.preview.defaultTemplate.descripti: Default render template name (matches `assets/templates/<name>.json` in tuack-ng). Leave empty for tuack-ng's default template.
config.preview.openBeside.description: Open the preview in a side column.
config.test.watchdogMinutes.description: Judging watchdog: if no output arrives for this long, treat the judge process as stuck and terminate it.
config.doc.checkOnSave.description: Run `doc check` automatically when a statement is saved and report the result in the Problems panel.
config.logLevel.description: Log level of the Tuack output channel.
capabilities.untrustedWorkspaces.descrip: Tuack runs local programs such as tuack-ng and typst, so related features are disabled in untrusted workspaces.
capabilities.virtualWorkspaces.descripti: Tuack needs a real file system and child processes.
